investigations.name: Stadtwerke Winsen (Luhe)
investigations.evidenceSummary: Current public m8mit inventory spans four pages and exposes operator EVSE classes Type 2 11 kW, Type 2 22 kW and CCS 150 kW. Current guest checkout samples across those classes expose Gasttarif - WIN at 0.60 EUR/kWh gross. No extra start/time/blocking component is displayed on the sampled checkout surfaces.
investigations.exactGap: No current operator-wide deterministic rule or exhaustive per-EVSE tariff extraction proves that every active DE*WIN EVSE inherits the sampled 0.60 EUR/kWh guest tuple and has no additional fee. After two evidence-led passes, park until a new exhaustive backend/export or first-party tariff rule appears.
